The Connect Gateway service allows connectivity from external parties to
connected Kubernetes clusters.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `GatewayControlClient`: GatewayControl is the control plane API for Connect Gateway.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `GatewayControlClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudGKEConnectGatewayV1

func sample() async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudGKEConnectGatewayV1.GatewayControlClient()
  let response = try await client.generateCredentials(
    request: GenerateCredentialsRequest()
  /* set fields using .with { $0... } */
)
  print("Success: \(response)")
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-gkeconnect-gateway-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-gkeconnect-gateway-v1.git --from 0.4.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudGKEConnectGatewayV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudGKEConnectGatewayV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-gkeconnect-gateway-v1
```
